payload.title: Every Story carries one persona from assignment to announcement
payload.description:
When a Story is assigned, the editor picks a persona from the section's list; an automated assignment rotates through the list. The persona is stored on the Story and kept through research, outline, draft, revisions and publication; the published byline and JSON-LD author come from it. An editor can change the persona before publication, and the change is recorded.
Scenario: an automated assignment in a section with personas A and B gives successive Stories A then B. Scenario: the published page and its JSON-LD name the Story's persona.
